description: A bearded man in a hooded cloak and wool tunic plays a bowed fiddle in a stone hall with timber rafters. A harpist stands at the left edge. A fire burns at the centre with smoke, and rushes cover the floor. A man sits in an ornate carved chair, and robed medieval people watch from the right, including an older man in red on a bench. Banners hang from the rafters and a shield is on the wall. Fills the image edge to edge, no text, nothing graphic.
